Ascension is the process of raising one's [[toposophic level]]. It can also refer to the more granular processes of [[minor ascension]] including [[adolescent ascension]], [[health ascension]], and [[educational ascension]].

All ascension is intrinsically risky. All ascension has a risk of causing [[tripping]].

[[Faustery]] is the process of ascension either while not in a state of [[nobility]] or while in a state of nobility and not taking due dilligence to maintain that state

[[Apotheosis]] is the process of ascension where one maintains a state of nobility throughout it. Occasionally one can still [[trip]] while undergoing Apotheosis ([[apotheotic tripping]]) as ascension is an unpredictable process
